Facts:
Mateo and Yi Rodriguez (hereinafter the Debtors) filed for bankruptcy on April 10th 2024. The Beretta A300 Outlander semi-auto 12-gauge sporting shotgun belonging to the Rodriguezes has an appraisal value of $1,000.00. Mateo and Yi Rodriguez own a four-bedroom, three-bath brick ranch homestead with a finished basement and a wood-burning fireplace worth $558,750.00. The birthstone ring in sterling silver setting, owned by Mateo and Yi, holds a monetary value of $140.00.
